name: loja-informatica
description: Monorepo da Loja de Informatica: apps/app (Next.js - Monte seu PC + Painel CRM), apps/agent (Evolution API WhatsApp) e packages/db (Prisma/PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run generate -w @loja/db && npm run build -w @loja/catalog && npm run build -w @loja/db && npm run build -w @loja/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @loja/catalog && npm run typecheck -w @loja/db && npm run typecheck -w @loja/agent && npm run typecheck -w @loja/app
